name: Tsuguya Inoue
introduction: Born in Miyazaki, in 1947. Established Beans in 1978. Art direction for Parco, Suntory, COMME des GARCONS, Asahi Shimbun, publishes, music and TV commercials. Also has directed advertisements and photo books. Produced NPB symbol mark, awarded for Tokyo ADC grand prix and other prizes, Tokyo TDC Grand prix and book design, The Yamana Prize at Japan Advertising Award. Tokyo ADC, Tokyo TDC, JAGDA member.
